entry_points.text: Modern semctl forwards with fixed 64-bit selector; legacy normalizes cmd; compat narrows and masks; legacy compat parses then delegates.
Untimed 64-bit timed 32-bit timed and compat semop converge on common routine with optional timeout.
Shmget uses shared lookup with create assoc and size checks; native legacy and compat shmctl delegate to central dispatcher.
Info reports limits and usage; stat has standard and Linux positional forms; attach forwards to helper; multiplex demuxes opcode with version in high bits.

exports.text: Expose version aware semctl plus timed semop for native compat and in-kernel callers plus undo share on clone and drain on exit.
Expose normal and huge file tables plus area table with open close fault split pagesize and policy hooks.
Expose attach and detach plus key privatization plus boot proc registration and initial namespace setup.

hazards.text: SETVAL differs by width endian; sem ids recycle revalidate treat invalid undo as removal; shm reuse by file mismatch races warned validate pointers.
Attach end may wrap overlap or exceed extent detach width mismatch checked; teardown races mitigated by file ref locked validation paired count retained ref.
Faulty buffers interruptible locks bad selectors misaligned addresses removed objects report distinct failure without partial change except count adjustments.

invariants.text: Copy honors 64-bit full vs old ownership-mode; compat splits times; dispatchers reject negative ids and route info stat array value set remove.
Op vector bounded with stack or dynamic store; core validates length id timeout index rights; undo reuses or creates linked record; clone shares only with flag.
Proc show emits key id mode counts mapped ids times rss swap; boot inits subsystems; key hash anchors in perm; obtain wraps checked vs positional lookup.
Create rejects small size page or total wrap and over allowance; published segment has masked mode security backing and zero attaches; failures unwind; rss scales huge vs shmem.
Removal privatizes key and defers when attached else tears down; eligible only with zero attaches plus forced removal or DEST under lock; orphan scan skips linked creators.
Control is info usage stat set remove lock; lock needs cap or owner plus rlimit; stat audits revalidates exports perm size times pids; copies clear cap max split times permission-only.
Attach checks alignment fixed remap prot and access security; detach checks shm ops offset or exact start; sync alloc unmapped delegate; multiplex selects by low bits version high.
Rely on external helpers for errors RCU lists locks tasks user copy compat audit security fs hugetlb mm proc rlimit warnings; internals elsewhere.

locks.text: Sem remove holds table write plus RCU then array guard; undo needs spin guard for mutate promote with RCU traversal and move hit to head.
Lookup under RCU locks object revalidates and returns locked with RCU held; by-ptr assumes ref; creator valid only non-empty under RCU; unlock releases guard.
Destroying detach holds namespace write plus object; orphan holds only object; exit unlinks then locks; control releases object first retains file; attach uses RCU object mmap and table locks.
Proc iteration holds object lock across show releases before advancing; position maps to index with offset under RCU plus object lock.

state_machines.text: Core tries atomic completion; blocking enqueues sleeps with timeout revalidates done signal timeout; exit drains last list applies clamped adjustments wakes defers free.
Open checks file match stamps increments; detach stamps decrements destroys when eligible; area ops delegate or default; map accounts then maps release frees.
Exit pins unlinks then destroys when eligible; locked sets on backing lock clears on unlock; attach increments before map decrements after.
Listing maps position to index with offset under RCU acquiring object lock on hit releasing previous before advancing.

Segment holds perm ns creator file size count times pids mlock with DEST in mode; wrapper links ns id file saved ops; task head collects creator nodes under task lock.
Legacy shm carries perm size times pids count; compat limits usage carry widths; kludge carries pointer type; proc iface iter carry path header selector namespaces.
